source.snippet: it was nice while it lasted. I guess my next step is a jev+cron to sort good from bad. Browser automation here we come. Someone want to write a Firefox extension that runs in your open browser tab? I would pay for this.

problem_statement: Developers and knowledge workers are drowning in AI-generated recruiter emails that look personalized but are not, and existing email clients provide no automated way to score or filter them; users are resorting to DIY cron jobs and browser automation.
target_segment: Software engineers and tech professionals receiving high recruiter email volume, especially those actively managing inboxes on Gmail or Outlook
notes: Explicit 'I would pay for this' from the poster. DIY workaround (cron + browser automation) confirms real friction. Adjacent to existing tools like SaneBox but focused specifically on AI-generated recruiter spam classification. Buyer: employed/job-hunting developer willing to pay for a browser extension or email plugin.
